fields.label: Department
fields.note: The only real control: the #jobOpenings tab strip (.openings-tab a[data-tab]) switches server-rendered panes (.tab-content > div[role=tabpanel]). Values are the data-tab labels; tab ids are engineering, deeplearning, product, business, account, customer, marketing, corporate, contribution.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: Printed on each card (.job-meta span) but not a portal control; local filter only.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: Printed on each card (.job-meta span) but not a portal control; local filter only.

notes: The careers page is a hand-maintained WordPress page. All job cards (36 .job-col nodes, 14 in the nine department panes plus cross-listed duplicates) are server-rendered; the only interaction is the department tab strip, which shows/hides panes in the browser and issues no request. There is no search box, no location/date/employment-type control and no pagination, so keyword and every other facet are applied locally. Apply links point at exact LinkedIn job postings or Google Forms.
